sentences: Selection sort ka smallest nikal ke swap kiya, phir poora array apne aap sort ho gaya.
Ek hi step mein sabse chhota 1 mila, toh baaki bhi apni jagah lag gaye honge.
Jab smallest ko a[0] pe bheja, toh poora array arrange ho gaya ek hi baar mein.
Array {3,4,1,2} tha, ek pass mein 1 aage aaya aur baaki numbers bhi line mein aa gaye.
Find smallest aur swap kiya, bas ek operation mein saare elements apni sahi position pe set ho gaye.
